Flags: Miniaturization · Egregious simplification Importance (not met): The undersized, lightweight chassis on open ledges does not test the heavy server handling and rail engagement relevant to data-center work. Construct validity (not met): The fixture substitutes a staging block and broad fixed ledges for a server rack and its mating slide rails. Scoring (not met): The scorer checks chassis x position and orientation but not actual ear-to-post contact, rail support or chassis height, allowing full credit without proper seating. Clarity and reproducibility (not met): Each ear is separated from the chassis body by a 20 mm gap, leaving the specified physical chassis construction unclear. The task substitutes a small, lightweight box on open ledges for installing a server in its rack rails, removing the weight and rail-engagement challenges of the real operation. The scorer also needs to verify actual rail support and both ears' contact, rather than only the chassis position and orientation. If you think this misjudges your task, reply on this pull request within 48 hours and a person will review it. This task doesn’t meet the importance bar, so it can’t be revised, and this pull request is now closed. You’re welcome to submit a different task in a new pull request.
